title: Scientists make stunning discovery that could help explain why life exists
caption:
Could life exist in a universe where water behaves like tar? A new study suggests the fundamental laws of physics place strict limits on how fluids move, potentially dictating whether biological processes can function at all. It turns out, the secret to life might be written in the flow of a liquid.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists make stunning discovery that could help explain why life exists
